summary: Iteration 4 testing of the new 'Play the story' guided tour (15 beats) plus regression. All 24 backend pytest tests still green. Frontend tour verified end-to-end: play-story-btn on landing launches tour with autoplay ON, step 1 resets to Harrington v2.0, all 15 steps navigate to correct routes and fire scripted backend actions (upload → 4 OBSERVED claims → VERIFIED → PROPOSED changeset → v3.0 established → timeline evt_succession → obligation OPEN → beneficiary lens → RAC → oversight attention → escalate → send comm → v4.0 with SENT Beneficiary Notice → evidence tabs v2.0/v3.0/v4.0 → finish). Autoplay auto-advanced from 1 → 3 within 22s. Back navigation is non-destructive (comms stayed at 1 after back through step 13; v3.0 preserved after back from step 7 → 6). Exit hides tour-card and play-story-btn reappears. topbar-play-story-btn works inside lens and is hidden while tour active. Reset-demo + Morgan matter-selector regression passes; Morgan dashboard shows v4.0 with start-governed-change banner.
critical_code_review_comments: TourCard.jsx useEffect uses `lastRun.current === idx` guard to avoid re-running actions on Back — correct and elegant. eslint-disable-next-line for missing deps (navigate, step, refresh, switchMatter, setBusy) is intentional but could be silenced by listing them since they are stable.
AUTO_MS=9000 * 14 remaining steps = ~2min run; acceptable for a demo but consider surfacing a progress ETA in the card.
tour.js step 12 escalate & step 13 send actions are properly idempotent-guarded (only fire if OPEN / not SATISFIED) — confirmed by comms count staying at 1 after Back navigation.
server.py still monolithic (~670 lines) — cosmetic; unchanged since iteration 3.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/reset used to reseed both matters between phases.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tour testids all working: play-story-btn, topbar-play-story-btn (hidden while tour active), tour-card, tour-step-counter (formatted 'N / 15' with spaces), tour-step-title, tour-step-text, tour-autoplay-btn (label 'Pause' / 'Autoplay'), tour-busy, tour-back-btn (disabled on step 1 and while busy), tour-next-btn (disabled while busy), tour-finish-btn (only on step 15), tour-exit-btn. Autoplay fires next after AUTO_MS=9000ms once busy clears. Step actions are idempotent-guarded on escalate/send so Back is non-destructive. Regression flows for Morgan matter-switcher and reset-demo still work. Backend pytest suite (24 tests) still 100%.
